title: Lesson 1 Quiz: How Stock Markets Actually Work

questions.text: What does owning a share of stock in a publicly listed company represent?
options: A loan made to the company that must be repaid with interest
Partial ownership of the underlying corporate business
A guaranteed monthly payout from the stock exchange
A temporary membership card to use the company's services
questions.explanation: Buying a share gives an investor partial ownership in the actual underlying business.

questions.text: True or false: Stock prices fluctuate primarily based on the balance of supply and demand among buyers and sellers.
questions.explanation: Stock prices rise when demand to buy exceeds supply to sell and fall when selling supply outweighs buying demand.
